text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oooh!
So this's what city plushies're like,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The ones back home were always a wee
bit faded,
but I don't see that here! Look
at how colorful the
fabric is!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch, Trainer. Now I've got
someth'n
t'decorate my room with!
